NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply do hereby approve the acquisition of the immovableproperty, described in the following Schedule, since this land potion is required by the National Water Supply and DrainageBoard, for the construction of waste water Treatment plant under Kattankudy treatment and disposal project.

RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Panning and Water Supply.Ministry of City Panning and Water Supply,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,14th October, 2015.5/2/1/1142.SCHEDULE
